The act of fasting can also help individuals develop greater self-discipline, self-awareness, and gratitude for the blessings in their lives. As you mentioned, this annual experience can "shift what feels important." It's likely that, over time, people who observe Ramadan may develop a greater appreciation for the values and principles that are emphasized during this month, such as kindness, generosity, and self-reflection. These values can, in turn, influence their priorities and decisions throughout the year, even after the month of Ramadan has ended. It's a beautiful example of how a collective, spiritual practice can shape individual values and contribute to personal growth, community cohesion, and a deeper sense of purpose.
